persistent_state.state_description: The main SQLite database gains the existing optimizer/repair state plus additive Dashboard compacted-source checkpoint, aggregate, usage, and bounded record-identity tables. Dashboard recovery stores fixed Shanghai day-window boundaries, a tuple cursor, processed rows, target generation-fence values, normalized aggregates, usage breakdowns, and list-limited identities; it does not copy payloads. NULL or blank replay-marker SHA values fail closed, stale markers re-enter repair, and a generation mismatch discards unpublishable staging. All new state is idempotent and forward-repairable; no allocator writeback, backup copy, destructive cleanup, or deployment state is introduced.
